rounds.text: AG Ventures Ltd trades at a highly attractive P/E multiple of 6.01x and a steep discount to its asset base with a price-to-book ratio of 0.50x on a book value of ₹ 271 [E1, E2]. Demonstrating a massive margin of safety of 50.9%, a discounted cash flow valuation puts intrinsic value at ₹ 277 per share compared to its current market price of ₹ 136 [E39, E40], supported by a reverse DCF showing that the current price already assumes an overly pessimistic -10.5% earnings growth [E41]. The business is undergoing a dramatic fundamental turnaround, highlighted by trailing twelve-month sales growth of 23% and profit growth of 271%, alongside a stellar quarterly operating margin of 53% in June 2026 compared to just 13% in the year-ago quarter [E11, E15, E25]. Operational efficiency is also surging, with the company's working capital requirements dramatically reduced from 533 days to 49.7 days [E47], all while operating in a supportive chemical sector tailwind with a tailwind score of +0.76 [E61, E63]. Conceded: the company has delivered a poor sales growth of -22.4% over the past five years alongside negative operating and free cash flows in March 2026 [E29, E30, E49].
